_about: Public-domain George Buist (1770-1808), Scottish-born minister of the First (Scots) Presbyterian Church, Charleston, South Carolina, and president of the College of Charleston, for the Word Hoard: his two volumes of Sermons (1809) and an oration at the Charleston orphan house (1795). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 107 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gbuist-oration-1795: An oration delivered at the orphan-house of Charleston, South-Carolina, October 18th, 1795, being the sixth anniversary of the institution. By the Reverend George Buist, ...  1795 (catalogued 1795)
gbuist-sermons-1: Sermons by the Reverend George Buist, D. D. : minister of the Presbyterian Church and President of the College of Charleston, South Carolina, vol. 1 (New York : Printed for E. Sargeant, by D. & G. Bruce, 1809)

_excluded.gbuist-india: The Indian annals, Scinde narrative and science papers are by George Buist (1805-1860), the Bombay journalist, a different man
